chunks.label: Professional Summary
chunks.text:
Vincent Liu — QA Engineer / QA Automation Engineer
Direction: Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, and AI Engineering.

Vincent is a QA Engineer with experience across web applications, APIs, end-to-end business workflows, backend data validation, system integrations, and test automation.

His experience combines software quality with hands-on engineering practices, including JavaScript/Playwright automation, reusable test architecture, REST API testing, SQL-based data validation, CI/CD integration, debugging, and AI-assisted development.

The portfolio should present him as more than a manual tester. The core engineering story is:

**Understand the system → build reusable automation → investigate failures → trace data and integrations → validate behaviour → improve quality.**

---

chunks.label: P97 — Fleet Platform
chunks.text:
P97 — QA Engineer (2023–2026)
Platform: Fleet Platform

Responsibilities:
- Developed and maintained reusable JavaScript and Playwright automation for web, API, and end-to-end workflows.
- Built reusable Page Objects, business components, and shared utilities to improve code reuse and maintainability.
- Worked with REST APIs using Postman and Swagger to validate requests, responses, JSON data, authentication, and system integrations.
- Used SQL to validate backend data and trace data flow across applications, APIs, and connected systems.
- Integrated automated tests into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for pull request validation, scheduled testing, and release verification.
- Used Mockoon to simulate dependent APIs and test integration workflows when external services were unavailable.
- Investigated application and automation failures using logs, API responses, test traces, and SQL data to identify root causes and verify fixes.
- Used Claude and GitHub Copilot to generate, debug, and improve JavaScript automation code and documentation. Reviewed and validated AI-generated outputs before implementation.
- Tested AI-powered features and validated AI-generated results against expected business rules and application behaviour.
- Wrote BDD scenarios using Gherkin and implemented step definitions with Cucumber-JS and Playwright.
- Worked with developers, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to turn requirements into test scenarios and technical solutions.

Technology: JavaScript, Playwright, Cucumber-JS, Gherkin, REST APIs, Postman, Swagger, SQL, Mockoon, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Claude, GitHub Copilot
Focus areas: Reusable Automation, API & Integration, Data Validation, CI/CD, Root-Cause Investigation, AI-Assisted Development, BDD, E2E Testing
